findings: Service signatures changed: createAlbum(db, user, input), updateAlbum(db, user, id, input), moveAlbum(db, user, id, input), addSpin(db, user, id), deleteAlbum(db, user, id), replaceTracks(db, user, id, tracks), setCover(db, coversDir, user, id, upload), removeCover(db, coversDir, user, id). No other callers.

Check order keeps old status codes: create = 401, 400 missing crate, 403. Move/patch with crateId = 401, 404 missing album, 403 source, 400 missing target, 403 target. Target crate checked only when crateId changes.
POST /albums/:id/cover checks permission in the route before reading the multipart body, so anonymous/non-owner uploads are refused without buffering the file; setCover checks again.
Spins now need edit permission (as planned): anonymous visitors can no longer count plays. Web must only call spins for editable albums or ignore 401/403.
Schema validation still runs before services, so an anonymous request with an invalid body gets 400, not 401.
